verdict.line: You lose the poke war before level 6 if you walk into Parrrley range without a shield up, but you win the lane from mid-game once your Q cooldown drops and your tank items land.

brief.thesis: Gangplank's Parrrley reaches 625 range, 75 units past Sion's 550-range Q, and his passive poison ticks on every auto he lands, which is exactly why he holds the solo-kill edge in this matchup. Sion's W shield is built to absorb that kind of ranged chip, and his stun-into-health-for-AD kit scales into longer fights, which is why the lane sits even on paper across 207 games even though Sion actually wins it 55.6% of the time.

theirWindow.when: you're outside 550 range, his Q up
theirWindow.what: He can freely land Parrrley and stack passive poison without any retaliation since you can't reach him with Cryptic Gaze. Back off and let the shield soak it instead of trading autos.

yourWindow.when: you're inside 550 range, his W down
yourWindow.what: Land Q (Cryptic Gaze) for the stun, flip E (Enrage) on, and commit fully since Remove Scurvy can't clear the CC or heal him out of it. This is your all-in window.

boots.why: 70.1% pick rate, 53% WR over 183 games — reduces the repeated auto-attack damage from a champion whose whole kit is built around landing basic attacks and poison stacks.

core.why: Gives you the health and AoE pressure to punish him for standing in melee range after a failed poke.

runes.keystoneWhy: Heals you back through the exact poke-and-poison pattern Gangplank relies on, and the bonus health compounds with Enrage's permanent max-health growth on kills.

summoners.why: 87.6% pick rate at 54.6% WR — Teleport lets you reset safely after shoving with E/W and scale into your power windows, while Flash covers both landing Q stuns and escaping Parrrley range when you're caught overextended.

playing.title: Shield before you walk up
playing.detail: Pop W (Death's Caress) before entering his Q range so the shield eats the Parrrley poke and passive poison instead of your health. If it survives, it still detonates for AoE damage once he commits to melee.

playing.title: Trade only inside 550 range
playing.detail: Parrrley reaches 625, 75 units past Cryptic Gaze's 550 range. Stepping up without a stun ready just hands him free pokes — only commit once you can actually threaten Q.

playing.title: Hold Q for his W cooldown
playing.detail: Remove Scurvy (22/21/20/19/18s CD) clears your stun and heals him, so don't waste Cryptic Gaze into it. Wait for the window right after he's used it.

playing.title: Toggle E for trades, not travel
playing.detail: Enrage converts your health into AD on every auto, so only flip it on when you're actually swinging — walking around with it active just bleeds health into his poison stacks.

playing.title: Respect the global ult timer
playing.detail: Cannon Barrage has no lane counterplay and can land on your push. Track his ultimate's 120/115/110/120/120s cooldown during extended skirmishes so you're not caught overextended when it lands.

playing.title: Scale through items, not all-ins
playing.detail: His solo-kill edge is real early — trade evenly through laning phase rather than forcing fights, and let Sunfire Aegis and Unending Despair take over by mid-game.

playing.title: Save R for sustained fights
playing.detail: Cannibalism (90s CD) leeches health per attack and buffs attack speed, so it rewards prolonged contact. Use it in extended skirmishes, not opening bursts.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, summoner spells, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the ability readings, timing windows, and tactical reasoning are my own analysis of the kit interactions.
